morphology_rules: Pointed external ears are a primary persistent species-readable feature in the supplied reference set.
Strongly angled/up-swept eyebrow presentation is a recurring screen cue but should not erase individual facial variation.
Underlying facial structure remains broadly individual.
Haircut is presentation state, not species anatomy.
identity_rules: Ear geometry must stay stable for a persistent individual unless an explicit injury/medical event changes it.
A later portrait may change hair, age and clothing but must preserve face identity.
forbidden: blank facial expression as species requirement
one canonical character face reused as procedural template
